title: Hosea 1:1 (#1)
content:
Who was Hosea’s father?

Hosea’s father was Beeri.

title: Hosea 1:2 (#1)
content:
What kind of wife did Yahweh tell Hosea to take for himself?

Yahweh told him to marry a prostitute.

title: Hosea 1:3 (#1)
content:
Whom did Hosea marry?

Hosea married Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim.

title: Hosea 1:4 (#1)
content:
Why was Hosea told to name his first son Jezreel?

Hosea was told to name his son Jezreel because Yahweh was soon going to punish the descendants of Jehu for the people he had slaughtered at Jezreel.

title: Hosea 1:5 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to Israel’s army in the Valley of Jezreel?

Yahweh said he would destroy Israel’s army in the Valley of Jezreel.

title: Hosea 1:6 (#1)
content:
What name did Yahweh tell Hosea to give his daughter?

Yahweh told him to call her Lo Ruhamah.

title: Hosea 1:7 (#1)
content:
On whom will Yahweh have compassion?

Yahweh will have compassion on the people of Judah.

title: Hosea 1:8 (#1)
content:
What did Gomer do after she weaned Lo Ruhamah?

She conceived and gave birth to another son.

title: Hosea 1:9 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh tell Hosea to name of his second son Lo Ammi?

Hosea was told to name his son Lo Ammi to show that the Israelites were no longer Yahweh’s people.

title: Hosea 1:10 (#1)
content:
What will be said to those who formerly were told they were not Yahweh’s people?

It will be said to them that they are sons of the living God.

title: Hosea 1:11 (#1)
content:
What will the people of Judah and Israel do together in the future?

They will unite and choose one leader for themselves.

title: Hosea 2:1 (#1)
content:
What should the people say to their brothers and sisters?

They should say to their brothers, “Ammi,” and to their sisters, “Ruhamah.”

title: Hosea 2:2–3 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do if Israel (the prostitute) does not put away her prostitution?

If Israel (the prostitute) does not put away her prostitution, Yahweh will strip her naked and show her nakedness as on the day that she was born.

title: Hosea 2:4 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh not have compassion on Israel’s (the prostitute’s) children?

Yahweh will not have compassion on her children, because they are as unfaithful as their prostitute mother.

title: Hosea 2:5 (#1)
content:
What did the children’s mother say she would do?

She said she would go after her lovers, who gave her bread, water, wool, linen, oil, and wine to drink.

title: Hosea 2:6 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to block Israel’s (the prostitute’s) way?

He will block her way with thorns and build a wall in her way so that she does not know what to do.

title: Hosea 2:7 (#1)
content:
Why will Israel (the prostitute) return to her first husband?

She will return to her first husband because she thinks it was better for her then than now.

title: Hosea 2:8 (#1)
content:
Who gave Israel (the prostitute) silver and gold?

Yahweh gave them silver and gold, which the people used to make idols for Baal.

title: Hosea 2:9 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh take back from Israel (the prostitute)?

He will take back his grain, new wine, wool, and linen that were meant to cover their bodies.

title: Hosea 2:10 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to Israel (the prostitute) in front of her lovers?

Yahweh will expose their shameful behavior in front of their (gods) lovers.

title: Hosea 2:11 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh cause to cease?

He will cause all their celebrations to cease.

title: Hosea 2:12 (#1)
content:
What wages did Israel’s (the prostitute’s) lovers give her?

Israel’s lovers gave her grapevines and fig trees.

title: Hosea 2:13 (#1)
content:
What did Israel (the prostitute) do when she went after her lovers?

They burned incense to the Baals, put on their jewelry, and forgot Yahweh.

title: Hosea 2:14 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to persuade Israel (the prostitute)?

He will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.

title: Hosea 2:15 (#1)
content:
How will Israel (the prostitute) answer Yahweh after he goes to win her back?

She will answer him as she did in the days of her youth, as in the days that she came out of the land of Egypt.

title: Hosea 2:16 (#1)
content:
In that day, what will Israel (the prostitute) call Yahweh?

She will call him “My Husband,” and no longer “My Baal.”

title: Hosea 2:17 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh remove from Israel’s (the prostitute’s) mouth?

He will not allow them to speak the names of the Baals, and they will never use those names again.

title: Hosea 2:18 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh allow his people do?

He will allow them to be able to live safely and peacefully.

title: Hosea 2:19 (#1)
content:
For how long did Yahweh promise his people they will belong to him?

Yahweh promised that they will belong to him forever.

title: Hosea 2:20 (#1)
content:
How will the people know that they truly will know Yahweh?

Yahweh will be faithful to them.

title: Hosea 2:21 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh answer on that day?

He will tell the heavens to send rain and water the earth.

title: Hosea 2:22 (#1)
content:
What will the earth provide for Jezreel?

The earth will produce grain, new wine and olive oil for Jezreel.

title: Hosea 2:23 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh say to Lo Ammi?

Yahweh will say to Lo Ammi, “You are my people.”

title: Hosea 3:1 (#1)
content:
In what way must Hosea love his wife?

Hosea must love her just as Yahweh loves the people of Israel.

title: Hosea 3:2 (#1)
content:
For how much did Hosea buy back his wife?

He bought her for fifteen pieces of silver and 335 liters of barley.

title: Hosea 3:3 (#1)
content:
What does Hosea tell his wife she must not do?

Hosea tells his wife that she must not be a prostitute and must not have sex with any other man.

title: Hosea 3:4–5 (#1)
content:
After the people of Israel live for many days without a king, who will they seek?

After the people of Israel live for many days without a king, they will again worship Yahweh their God.

title: Hosea 4:1 (#1)
content:
Against whom does Yahweh have a dispute?

Yahweh has a dispute with the people who live in the land.

title: Hosea 4:2 (#1)
content:
What sins does Yahweh say the people are committing?

The people are cursing, lying, murdering, stealing, and committing adultery.

title: Hosea 4:3 (#1)
content:
What is happening to everyone living in the land?

Everyone living in it is wasting away.

title: Hosea 4:4 (#1)
content:
What are the people like?

The people are like those who argue with a priest.

title: Hosea 4:5 (#1)
content:
Who will stumble by night?

The prophet will stumble along with the people by night.

title: Hosea 4:6 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh reject the people of Israel?

Yahweh will reject the people of Israel because they forgot and rejected the laws of their God.

title: Hosea 4:7 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do instead of honoring them because they sinned?

Yahweh will make people despise them instead of honoring them.

title: Hosea 4:8 (#1)
content:
What do the priests do with the sin offerings the people bring?

The priests eat the sin offerings, and they want the people to sin even more.

title: Hosea 4:9 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the priest, just as it happens to the people?

Yahweh will punish the priest the same as the people, paying them back for what they have done.

title: Hosea 4:10 (#1)
content:
What will happen even though the people eat?

They will eat but will still be hungry.

title: Hosea 4:11 (#1)
content:
What things make people unable to think clearly?

Prostitution, wine, and new wine make people unable to think clearly.

title: Hosea 4:12 (#1)
content:
What do Yahweh’s people ask to guide them?

They ask their wooden idols to guide them.

title: Hosea 4:13 (#1)
content:
Where do the people sacrifice and burn incense?

They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn incense on the hills, and under oak, poplar, and terebinth trees.

title: Hosea 4:14 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh not punish the people’s daughters when they choose to commit sexual immorality?

Yahweh will not punish the people’s daughters when they choose to commit sexual immorality, for the men also give themselves and offer sacrifices with the shrine prostitutes.

title: Hosea 4:15 (#1)
content:
Where should the people not go?

They should not go to Gilgal or Beth Aven to worship idols there.

title: Hosea 4:16 (#1)
content:
What is Israel compared to because of its stubbornness?

Israel is compared to a stubborn cow that refuses to obey.

title: Hosea 4:17 (#1)
content:
What has Ephraim chosen to do?

Ephraim has chose to worship idols.

title: Hosea 4:18 (#1)
content:
What did the leaders of Ephraim love?

The leaders of Ephraim loved shameful things.

title: Hosea 4:19 (#1)
content:
What will make the people ashamed?

Their sacrifices to idols will make them ashamed.

title: Hosea 5:1 (#1)
content:
Who does Yahweh tell to pay attention?

Yahweh tells the priests, the people of Israel, and the members of the royal court to pay attention because he is going to judge them.

title: Hosea 5:2 (#1)
content:
What have the revolters done, and what will Yahweh do to them?

They have killed many people, and Yahweh will punish all of them.

title: Hosea 5:3 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about Ephraim and Israel?

Yahweh says he knows that they have been unfaithful to him by worshiping idols and have made themselves unacceptable to him.

title: Hosea 5:4 (#1)
content:
What will not allow Ephraim to return to their God?

The evil things Ephraim has done will not allow them to worship their God any more.

title: Hosea 5:5 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Israel, Ephraim, and Judah because of their sin?

The people of Israel, Ephraim, and Judah will fail because of how much they have sinned.

title: Hosea 5:6 (#1)
content:
Why will the people not find Yahweh?

The people will not find Yahweh because he has removed himself from them.

title: Hosea 5:7 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to them when they bring their sacrifices to the festival?

Yahweh will kill them, because they have betrayed him and do not belong to him.

title: Hosea 5:8 (#1)
content:
Where should the trumpet and horn be blown?

The horn should be blown in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah, and the alarm sounded at Beth Aven.

title: Hosea 5:9 (#1)
content:
Who declared that Ephraim will become a desolation?

Yahweh declared that Ephraim will become desolate when he punishes them.

title: Hosea 5:10 (#1)
content:
On whom will Yahweh pour his wrath?

Yahweh will punish the leaders of Judah because of his wrath.

title: Hosea 5:11 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Ephraim when Yahweh judges them?

The people of Ephraim will suffer greatly because they were determined to worship worthless idols.

title: Hosea 5:12 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to Ephraim and Judah?

Yahweh will destroy the people of Ephraim like a moth destroys wool, and he will destroy the people of Judah like rot destroys wood.

title: Hosea 5:13 (#1)
content:
When did Ephraim go to Assyria?

When Ephraim saw that their nation was weak, then they went to Assyria for help.

title: Hosea 5:14 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will do to Ephraim and Judah?

Yahweh will cause soldiers to kill many of them and carry the others away, and there will be no one to rescue them.

title: Hosea 5:15 (#1)
content:
For how long will Yahweh leave them to themselves?

Yahweh will leave them to themselves until they admit that they have sinned and that they need him to forgive them; until they earnestly ask him to help them.

title: Hosea 6:1 (#1)
content:
Although Yahweh hurt his people, what will he then do?

Although he hurt them, he will heal them and bind up their wounds.

title: Hosea 6:2 (#1)
content:
When will Yahweh make his people strong again?

He will make them strong again after a short time so that they may live in his presence.

title: Hosea 6:3 (#1)
content:
What do the people say they need to do?

They say they need to try hard to know Yahweh.

title: Hosea 6:4 (#1)
content:
To what does Yahweh compare the people’s faithfulness?

He compares their faithful love for him to the mist or the dew in the morning; neither lasts very long.

title: Hosea 6:5 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do through the prophets?

He sent them to warn the people that he would judge them.

title: Hosea 6:6 (#1)
content:
What does God desire more than sacrifice?

God desired covenant faithfulness more than sacrifice, and the knowledge of him more than burnt offerings.

title: Hosea 6:7 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say the people did like Adam?

Like Adam, they broke his covenant and were unfaithful to him.

title: Hosea 6:8 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about the city of Gilead?

Gilead is a city full of people who do evil things and murder people.

title: Hosea 6:9 (#1)
content:
To what does the speaker compare the terrible and shameful things the priests have done?

The priests actions are compared to gangs of robbers who join together to commit murder on the way to Shechem.

title: Hosea 6:10 (#1)
content:
What horrible thing has Yahweh seen among the people of Israel?

Ephraim had become like a prostitute when they stopped worshiping him, and Israel’s sin had made them unacceptable to Yahweh.

title: Hosea 6:11 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he has appointed for Judah?

Yahweh said he has appointed a time when he will judge them, when he restores the fortunes of his people.

title: Hosea 7:1 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh see when he wants to heal Israel?

He sees how sinfully the people of Ephraim act and all of the evil things that the people of the city of Samaria do.

title: Hosea 7:2 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh remember?

Yahweh remembered every evil thing that they do.

title: Hosea 7:3 (#1)
content:
How did the people make the king glad?

The people of Israel please their king by doing evil things.

title: Hosea 7:4 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh compare the people to?

He compares them to adulterers because they are unfaithful to him.

title: Hosea 7:5 (#1)
content:
What happened to the king on the day of his festival?

The officials made him drunk with wine until he became sick, and he joined with those who mock Yahweh.

title: Hosea 7:6 (#1)
content:
What were the people’s hearts like?

Their hearts were as hot with anger as the heat of an oven.

title: Hosea 7:7 (#1)
content:
What happened to all the kings of Israel?

All of their kings died violently; yet none of them called out to Yahweh for help.

title: Hosea 7:8 (#1)
content:
What has ruined Ephraim?

Ephraim has become ruined because of his alliances with foreign nations.

title: Hosea 7:9 (#1)
content:
What did the people not realize was happening to them?

Foreigners have drained away their resources and their nation is becoming powerless yet the people of Israel do not realize it.

title: Hosea 7:10 (#1)
content:
What have the people of Israel not done despite everything that has happened?

They have not returned to worship Yahweh their God or tried to know him.

title: Hosea 7:11 (#1)
content:
What made Ephraim like a dove?

Ephraim was as foolish and stupid as a dove because they asked other nations instead of Yahweh to help them.

title: Hosea 7:12 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to them?

He will not allow them to succeed but instead will punish them.

title: Hosea 7:13 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh not rescue the people?

Yahweh did not rescue the people because they spoke lies against him.

title: Hosea 7:14 (#1)
content:
What did the people do instead of crying out to Yahweh for help?

They just lie on their beds and wail.

title: Hosea 7:15 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he did for the people?

He trained them and made them strong.

title: Hosea 7:16 (#1)
content:
Why will the officials die in battle?

The officials will die in battle because what they said made Yahweh very angry.

title: Hosea 8:1 (#1)
content:
Why was an enemy watching Yahweh’s people like a vulture watching over its prey?

Israel’s enemy was ready to invade the land where the people of Yahweh lived because they had broke his covenant and rebelled against his law.

title: Hosea 8:2 (#1)
content:
What do the people of Israel say to Yahweh?

They say that they know him as their God.

title: Hosea 8:3 (#1)
content:
What will happen because Israel has rejected what is good?

An enemy will chase after Israel.

title: Hosea 8:4 (#1)
content:
What did the people use to make idols for themselves?

They used their silver and gold to make idols for themselves.

title: Hosea 8:5 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about Samaria’s calf idol?

Yahweh says that he rejects it, and that he is very angry with the people of Samaria.

title: Hosea 8:6 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about the calf idol of Samaria?

He says a craftsman made it, so it is not God, and it will be broken into pieces.

title: Hosea 8:7 (#1)
content:
To what does the speaker compare the foolish things Israel has done?

The foolish plans the people have made are like they tried to plant the wind which of course will produce nothing good.

title: Hosea 8:8 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say Israel has become among the nations?

Israel has become just like the other nations, with nothing special about them.

title: Hosea 8:9 (#1)
content:
What has Ephraim done to get help from other nations?

Ephraim has gone to Assyria and paid other nations to be their allies.

title: Hosea 8:10 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do now that they have paid other nations to help them?

Now that they paid another nation to help them, Yahweh will punish them by making them suffer under the demands of the king of that nation.

title: Hosea 8:11 (#1)
content:
What happened to the altars that Ephraim built to take away sin?

Those altars became places where Ephraim sinned even more.

title: Hosea 8:12 (#1)
content:
Even if Yahweh wrote down his law for them ten thousand times, how would they view it?

They would still consider that it did not apply to them.

title: Hosea 8:13 (#1)
content:
How will Yahweh punish the people’s sins?

He will punish their sins by making them become slaves again, like they were in Egypt.

title: Hosea 8:14 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say Israel did?

Israel forgot the God who made them and built palaces for themselves instead.

title: Hosea 9:1 (#1)
content:
Why should Israel not rejoice?

Israel should not rejoice because they have been unfaithful to their God.

title: Hosea 9:2 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Israel’s food supply?

There will not be enough grain or wine to feed them.

title: Hosea 9:3 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the people of Ephraim?

Ephraim will no longer live in the land Yahweh gave them, but will return to slavery and eat unclean food in Assyria.

title: Hosea 9:4 (#1)
content:
How does Yahweh respond to Israel’s offerings and sacrifices?

Their offerings sacrifices will not be pleasing to Yahweh.

title: Hosea 9:5 (#1)
content:
What will the people no longer be able to do once they are in exile?

They will not be able to celebrate the feasts and festivals that Yahweh has appointed for them.

title: Hosea 9:6 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Israel’s treasures of silver?

Weeds will take over their precious silver and thorns will fill their tents.

title: Hosea 9:7 (#1)
content:
Why is God going to punish the Israelites?

Because of Israel’s great iniquity and great hostility.

title: Hosea 9:8 (#1)
content:
What is the role of the prophet?

The prophet is the watchman with God over Ephraim.

title: Hosea 9:9 (#1)
content:
To what does Hosea compare Israel’s current corruption?

He compares it to just how sinful the people of Gibeah were long ago.

title: Hosea 9:9 (#2)
content:
What will God do about Israel’s sins?

God will punish them for how wickedly they have acted.

title: Hosea 9:10 (#1)
content:
What did Israel’s ancestors do when they came to Baal Peor?

They devoted themselves to the worship of shameful idol.

title: Hosea 9:12 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will do even if the people of Ephraim is able to raise children?

He will take away every one of them.

title: Hosea 9:13 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Ephraim’s children?

Their children will be slaughtered by their enemies.

title: Hosea 9:14 (#1)
content:
What does Hosea ask Yahweh to give to Ephraim?

He asks Yahweh to give them miscarriages and no way to nurse babies.

title: Hosea 9:15 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will do because of the evil things the people of Israel have done?

Yahweh will drive them out of the land and will no longer love them no.

title: Hosea 9:16 (#1)
content:
What would happen even if Ephraim had children?

Even if they have children, Yahweh will kill the children whom they love.

title: Hosea 9:17 (#1)
content:
Why does God reject Israel?

God rejects Israel because they have not listened to him.

title: Hosea 9:17 (#2)
content:
What will happen to Israel after God rejects them?

They will become wanderers among the nations.

title: Hosea 10:1 (#1)
content:
What happened as the people of Israel became more prosperous?

The more the people prospered, the more altars they built.

title: Hosea 10:2 (#1)
content:
What is the consequence of the people’s sin?

Yahweh will destroy their sacred altars and pillars.

title: Hosea 10:3 (#1)
content:
Why did they no longer have a king?

They had no king because they had not feared or honored Yahweh.

title: Hosea 10:4 (#1)
content:
Why were the covenants the people made worthless?

Israel made covenants that they did not keep.

title: Hosea 10:5 (#1)
content:
What will the people of Samaria do because of the calf idol of Beth Aven?

They will be afraid about what will happen to the idol, and the people and priests will mourn and cry out because it is gone.

title: Hosea 10:6 (#1)
content:
Why will the calf idol of Beth Aven be carried to Assyria?

It will be carried to Assyria as a gift for the its king.

title: Hosea 10:7 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the king of Samaria?

He will be no more, like a chip of wood floating away on the water.

title: Hosea 10:8 (#1)
content:
What will grow over the altar?

Thorns and thistles will grow over the altar.

title: Hosea 10:9 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the wicked people of Gibeah?

War will overtake them.

title: Hosea 10:10 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do when he decides to punish them?

He will allow armies from other nations to attack and capture them.

title: Hosea 10:11 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh make the people of Ephraim, Judah, and Jacob do?

Yahweh will make Ephraim work hard, Judah will have to plow, and Jacob will have to break up the ground with no one to help them.

title: Hosea 10:12 (#1)
content:
For how long should the people seek Yahweh?

They should seek Yahweh until he comes and blesses them.

title: Hosea 10:13 (#1)
content:
What did the people trust in for their security rather than in Yahweh?

They trusted that their many warriors would protect them.

title: Hosea 10:14 (#1)
content:
What happened to mothers with their children when Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel?

When Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel, mothers were dashed to pieces with their children.

title: Hosea 10:15 (#1)
content:
Why will the king of Israel be destroyed at Bethel?

The king will be destroyed because of the wickedness of the people.

title: Hosea 11:1 (#1)
content:
From where did Yahweh call Israel when Israel was a young nation?

When Israel was a child, Yahweh brought them out of Egypt.

title: Hosea 11:2 (#1)
content:
What did the Israelites keep doing instead of listening to Yahweh?

The Israelites kept offering sacrifices to the Baal gods and burning incense to honor their statues.

title: Hosea 11:3 (#1)
content:
Who taught Ephraim to walk?

Yahweh taught Ephraim to walk.

title: Hosea 11:4 (#1)
content:
How did Yahweh lead his people?

Yahweh gently guided them because he loved them.

title: Hosea 11:5 (#1)
content:
Who will rule over them since they refuse to worship Yahweh?

The king of Assyria will rule over them because they refused to worship Yahweh any more.

title: Hosea 11:6 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Israel’s cities because of their evil plans?

Enemies will attack their cities with swords, destroy the bars of their gates, and kill the people.

title: Hosea 11:7 (#1)
content:
What are Yahweh’s people determined to do?

Yahweh’s people are determined to turn away and stop worshiping him.

title: Hosea 11:8 (#1)
content:
What happened to the cities of Admah and Zeboiim that Yahweh wants to avoid doing to Ephraim and Israel?

Yahweh doesn’t want to destroy Ephraim and Israel the way he destroyed the cities of Admah and Zeboiim because he loves them too much.

title: Hosea 11:9 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh not destroy Ephraim again?

Although Yahweh is extremely angry, he will not destroy Ephraim again, for he is God and not a human.

title: Hosea 11:10 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the people when Yahweh calls out?

The Israelites will return to Yahweh and will come back from lands around the sea.

title: Hosea 11:11 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will do when the people return?

He will settle them in their homes again.

title: Hosea 11:12 (#1)
content:
Who still follows God?

Judah still remains faithful and obeys God.

title: Hosea 12:1 (#1)
content:
What did Ephraim do to get help from other nations?

Ephraim made a treaty with Assyria and sent oil to Egypt.

title: Hosea 12:2 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh punish Jacob for?

Yahweh punished the descendants of Jacob for how they lived and the things they had done.

title: Hosea 12:3 (#1)
content:
What did Jacob do in the womb?

In the womb, Jacob grabbed his brother by the heel.

title: Hosea 12:4 (#1)
content:
Where did God speak to Jacob?

God spoke with Jacob at Bethel.

title: Hosea 12:5 (#1)
content:
By what name were the people commanded to call God?

The name “Yahweh” is the name that he commanded the people to always use.

title: Hosea 12:6 (#1)
content:
For what should the people wait?

They should wait continually for their God by trusting in him.

title: Hosea 12:7 (#1)
content:
What do the merchants use to cheat people?

The merchants use dishonest scales to cheat people.

title: Hosea 12:8 (#1)
content:
What did Ephraim claim no one would find in his work?

He boasted that in all of his labor, no one will find anything wrong that would be considered sin.

title: Hosea 12:9 (#1)
content:
Where did the people live when Yahweh brought them out of Egypt?

The people lived in tents when they left the land of Egypt.

title: Hosea 12:10 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh use the prophets to give to the people?

Yahweh used the prophets to give visions and parables to the people.

title: Hosea 12:11 (#1)
content:
What will Gilgal’s altars be like?

Gilgal’s altars will be like piles of stones left on a plowed field.

title: Hosea 12:12 (#1)
content:
Where did Jacob flee?

Jacob fled to the land of Aram to escape from his brother Esau.

title: Hosea 12:13 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do by a prophet?

Yahweh used the prophet Moses when he brought Israel up from Egypt, and by that same prophet, he took care of them.

title: Hosea 12:14 (#1)
content:
What will Ephraim’s Lord do to him?

His Lord will hold Ephraim responsible for the bloodshed and give him what he deserves.

title: Hosea 13:1 (#1)
content:
Why did Ephraim become guilty?

He became guilty by worshiping Baal.

title: Hosea 13:2 (#1)
content:
What do the people have made from their silver?

Skilled craftsmen make idols for the people from their silver.

title: Hosea 13:3 (#1)
content:
What happens to chaff?

Chaff is blown away from the threshing floor by the wind.

title: Hosea 13:4 (#1)
content:
Who does Yahweh say is the only savior for his people?

Yahweh says that he himself is the only savior for his people.

title: Hosea 13:5 (#1)
content:
Where did Yahweh remind the people that he had cared for them?

Yahweh cared for his people in the wilderness, in the dry desert land.

title: Hosea 13:6 (#1)
content:
What happened when the people’s hunger was satisfied?

When Yahweh’s people had enough to satisfy their hunger, they became proud and forgot him.

title: Hosea 13:7 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh be like to his people?

Yahweh will be like a fierce lion, and like a leopard that watches along the path to attack.

title: Hosea 13:8 (#1)
content:
Like what will Yahweh attack his people?

He will attack them like a bear that is robbed of her cubs.

title: Hosea 13:9 (#1)
content:
Why did Israel’s destruction happen?

Israel’s destruction happened because they rebelled against Yahweh, their helper.

title: Hosea 13:10 (#1)
content:
What did the people ask Yahweh to give them?

The people asked Yahweh to give them a king and princes.

title: Hosea 13:11 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do to the king he gave them?

Yahweh took the king away because of his wrath.

title: Hosea 13:12 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do with Ephraim’s sin?

Yahweh stores up and keeps a record of Ephraim’s sin.

title: Hosea 13:14 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh wish he could rescue the people from?

Yahweh wanted to save them from death.

title: Hosea 13:15 (#1)
content:
What will Ephraim’s enemy plunder?

His enemy will plunder the treasury of all their valuable objects.

title: Hosea 13:16 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Samaria’s young children?

Their young children will be dashed to pieces.

title: Hosea 14:1 (#1)
content:
Why should Israel begin to worship and obey Yahweh again?

Israel should return to worshiping Yahweh because terrible things are happening to them because of their sin.

title: Hosea 14:2 (#1)
content:
What does Israel ask Yahweh to do?

Israel asks Yahweh to forgive their sin since they now say they will do what is good.

title: Hosea 14:3 (#1)
content:
Who will not be able to save Israel?

Assyria will not save Israel.

title: Hosea 14:4 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh love Israel generously?

Yahweh will love them generously because he will no longer be angry with them.

title: Hosea 14:5 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will be like to Israel?

Yahweh says he will be like the dew that the refreshes the ground to Israel and they will prosper and become strong as the trees of Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:6 (#1)
content:
What will Israel’s splendor be like?

Israel’s splendor will be as majestic as an olive tree and as delightful as the aroma of the trees in Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:7 (#1)
content:
How will the people speak of Yahweh?

They will speak well of Yahweh, like they speak well of the fine wine of Lebanon.

title: Hosea 14:8 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about idols to Ephraim?

Yahweh says he wants nothing more to do with idols, and that he is the one who watches over them and is the source of everything good in their lives.

title: Hosea 14:9 (#1)
content:
Who will walk in the ways of Yahweh?

The righteous will walk in Yahweh’s ways and obey him.
